_comment: Bot-maintained rotation state for the dark-fantasy video pipeline. Do not hand-edit last_scene_index/scheduled_up_to/music_offset_seconds while the bot is running on schedule -- it owns these fields.
notes: posts_per_day TEMPORARILY set to 1 (2026-09-09) to keep the Minimax Hailuo test run cheap and minimal while confirming the new video model actually works -- set back to 3 once a run succeeds end-to-end. last_scene_index starts at -1 so the first run posts scene_bank.SCENES[0] first. scheduled_up_to is seeded to today so the first run's posts land tomorrow -- adjust this if you want the very first batch to post today instead.
